description: Response shapes for the Phase 10A backend raw-content query endpoints (email + calendar). These are the Python callable surfaces (construction.email.endpoints.*, construction.calendar.endpoints.*) used by CLI query commands, meeting prep, daily brief enrichment, MCP, and future model context builders. The metadata/redacted path is always available and unchanged from prior read models. Raw plaintext is only present when policy + effective params resolve to include.
invariants: No Graph tokens, no PEMs, no signed URLs, no raw deltas in any shape.
When _raw_content_included=false or absent, the item shape matches the pre-Phase10A redacted metadata (email_thread_summaries, email_messages, calendar_event_index).
Raw inclusion is gated by RawContentPolicy.raw_content.endpoints (allow_include_raw_param, default_raw_mode) + mode + starting_sources + explicit include_raw/raw_mode params.
Direct raw_* accessors return [] or None when not effective for the call (fail-closed).
JSON fields from raw tables are normalized to lists/objects in the endpoint responses for convenience.

list_threads.raw_included: same base + optional 'raw_content': {thread_subject, message_count, participant_count, messages: [{subject, body_text, body_html, from_name, from_address, to_recipients, ...}], source_refs } + _raw_content_included=true for those that had raw rows

list_messages.raw_included: base + per-message 'raw_content': {subject, body_text, body_html, from_*, *_recipients, sent/received, has_attachments, attachment_metadata} when a matching email_message_raw_content row exists

email.get_message: single email_messages row + optional raw_content sub-dict

direct_raw.list_email_message_raw_content: rows matching the email_message_raw_content table select (with JSON parsed)
direct_raw.list_email_thread_raw_context: rows matching email_thread_raw_context (messages_json parsed to list)

list_events.metadata_only: list of calendar_event_index rows (subject_hash etc, no body/join) + _raw_content_included=false
list_events.raw_included: base + 'raw_content' for matched: {subject, body_text, body_html, location, organizer:{name,email}, attendees: list, join_url, recurrence, start, end} + marker true

calendar.direct_raw: list/get_calendar_event_raw_content returning the V42 table columns (JSON parsed)

acceptance: Local callers (CLI graph mail threads, graph calendar events, brief builders, etc.) can obtain raw content when configured.
Metadata/redacted shapes and all no-raw downstreams (daily brief packets without raw, safety gates, etc.) remain bit-for-bit compatible when raw is excluded.
